what_happened: Scene: layout 7, red mug_5 in a dark-brown wooden upper cabinet (mushroom-like sweet potato distractor beside it), machine CoffeeMachine039 below. Stage 0: the arm reached into the cabinet and by 100-108 the mug filled the wrist view, centred between the fingers. The fingers closed at 104-116 (width 0.014) just in front of the mug wall instead of straddling it, touching nothing. The arm pulled back (140), and from ~300 to 1200 it hovered 10-20 cm in front of the mug, repeatedly closing on air with the mug well beyond the fingertips (closes at 479, 575, 621, 717, 830, all on nothing; closest approach 0.063 m to the mug centre). It never touched the mug; the mug never left the cabinet and stage 1 was never reached.
causal_chain: first close (104-116) lands just short of the mug wall -> arm backs off -> 900 steps of hovering in front of the mug with repeated closes on air at 10-20 cm -> mug never picked -> timeout
self_recovery: five more closes (479-830), all well short of the mug; no successful re-approach.
uncertain_about: Whether the first close was short (in front of the wall) or high (above the rim): depth is not visible in the wrist view; the packet shows no contact at all.
